title: Earthward

screenshots.comment: Procedural World Generation tool in Unity
Character Selection UI with unlockable characters

description: I led development across gameplay systems, content creation, and production for Earthward. My work included netcode, combat and progression systems, editor tooling, software tooling, and shader and materials programming that supported both the game's look and the team's iteration workflow.

title: Midnight Delivery

screenshots.comment: Data-table driven quest and dialogue system
Toon outline shader and depth-based water

description: As Tech Lead and Quality Advocate, I helped drive technical direction, production quality, and team reliability on Midnight Delivery. My work included physics and shader programming, creating the CI/CD pipeline in Jenkins, identifying and resolving quality issues, and helping keep the project stable and shippable across development.

title: Bitlands

screenshots.comment: Badge collection, serialized and linked to Steam achievements

description: I was the sole developer on Bitlands, owning the project from implementation through shipping it on Steam. My work centered on building gameplay systems, solving technical problems, and turning the design vision into a polished player experience.

title: Lilypad Lowdown
description: I worked as a programmer on Lilypad Lowdown during a game jam, implementing gameplay systems and supporting the project's core combat and progression flow under a tight deadline. My responsibilities included building features quickly, fixing issues during development, and helping the game feel responsive and complete within the jam scope.

title: Daisy's Quest
description: As the programmer on Daisy's Quest during a game jam, I built gameplay and puzzle mechanics that supported the project's central design ideas on a compressed schedule. I was responsible for implementing systems, refining interactions, and making sure the game logic supported the intended player experience within the time limit.

title: Koko: The Last Leaf
description: I contributed as the composer for Koko: The Last Leaf, writing music that supported the tone, pacing, and emotional arc of the game. My work focused on reinforcing atmosphere and helping key moments feel memorable through the soundtrack.

title: Fresh Fruits
description: I contributed to Fresh Fruits as a programmer, artist, and composer, giving me ownership across multiple parts of the project. I helped build gameplay systems, create visual assets, and produce music that supported both the game's style and its moment-to-moment feel.

title: Paradigm
description: I worked as the composer for Paradigm, creating music that matched the game's strange tone and puzzle-driven pacing. My responsibility was to support the project's identity through audio and help each area feel more intentional and immersive.

title: Seashore Siege
description: As a programmer on Seashore Siege, I implemented gameplay features and supported the systems that drove the tower defense experience. My work focused on making the game loop function cleanly, improving interactions, and helping the project come together as a complete prototype.

title: Glow Engine

screenshots.comment: Snippet of a custom .obj model parser (C++)

description: I created Glow Engine as a custom 3D engine in DirectX 11 to support my own RPG development workflow. My work includes engine architecture, rendering systems, editor tooling, collision and physics, and the serialized component pipeline used to build game content.

title: Earth Engine

screenshots.comment: Top-down demo project developed in Earth Engine

description: I built Earth Engine as a cross-platform 2D engine in C# with MonoGame, with a strong focus on rapid content creation and iteration. My responsibilities included the runtime architecture, editor tools, gameplay support systems, and the technical foundation used to develop larger RPG projects.

title: Lynx Engine
description: I served as a graphics programmer on Lynx Engine, contributing rendering-focused systems within a seven-person engine team. My work centered on the graphics pipeline, visual systems, and engine-level technical features that supported both tooling and gameplay development.

title: Graphics Engine
description: I created this graphics engine as a focused technical project to deepen my understanding of rendering and engine architecture. The work involved implementing 3D geometry generation, lighting, and core DirectX 11 rendering systems from the ground up.

title: Room Editor
description: I built Room Editor to speed up level creation and support chunk-based world generation for Earthward. My responsibilities included the editing workflow, data serialization, and usability features that made the tool practical for real content production.

title: Behavior Tree Editor
description: I created the Behavior Tree Editor to support enemy AI authoring and iteration for Earthward. My work focused on the editor interface, node system design, and export pipeline so behaviors could be built visually and integrated cleanly into the game.

title: Earth Edit
description: I built Earth Edit to streamline data authoring for items, accessories, and other game content in Earthward. My responsibilities included designing the schema-driven editing workflow, JSON export pipeline, and the supporting UI used to manage content efficiently.

title: Budget Master
description: I developed Budget Master as a full budgeting application focused on practical financial tracking and planning. My work included building the app's core features, data flow, and visual reporting tools so users could manage budgets and understand spending patterns more clearly.

title: Kira AI Agent
description: I built Kira AI Agent as an assistant-oriented application designed around automation, contextual responses, and task support. My responsibilities included shaping the interaction flow, integrating AI-driven behaviors, and building the surrounding application logic that made the tool useful in practice.

title: Portfolio
description: I designed and developed this portfolio site to present my work through custom carousels, media showcases, and a data-driven project system. My responsibilities included the front-end UI, interaction design, reusable project architecture, and the overall presentation strategy used to communicate both polish and technical ability.

title: Archery Overhaul
description: I developed Archery Overhaul as a large Terraria mod centered on expanding ranged combat progression. My work included designing and implementing new content, progression paths, and supporting systems across weapons, accessories, materials, and NPC interactions.

title: Spear Overhaul
description: I created Spear Overhaul to expand the spear subclass in Terraria with new progression, mechanics, and supporting gear. My responsibilities included system design, implementation of new items and behaviors, and balancing the experience so the subclass felt more complete and rewarding.

title: Sorcery Overhaul
description: I built Sorcery Overhaul as a large-scale Terraria mod focused on improving mage progression and making magic combat more satisfying. My work involved designing and implementing new items, armor sets, progression structures, and mana-based mechanics to create a fuller class experience.

title: Riptide's Mod
description: I created Riptide's Mod as both a Terraria mod and a teaching project for demonstrating tModLoader development. My responsibilities included building example content, structuring the code in a way that was approachable to learners, and producing a project that could support educational walkthroughs.
